known_caveats: Positive biological results support sampled occurrence. Zero or missing rows require explicit protocol review.
source_warnings: Historical sampled occurrence only; current persistence, establishment, countywide prevalence and protocol completion are not established.
The WQX 2.2 profile excludes USGS data added after March 11,2024; complete query response counts are not a complete current national inventory.
Zero, blank, negative, provisional, quality-control, toxicity, unidentified and method-held rows create no absence or non-detection claim.
Organization/activity/site identities and anonymous raw result locators are preserved. Identical disclosed fields need not identify the same specimen; repeated rows are never summed into progress.

County assignment follows unambiguous official Station metadata. Coarse generalized map boundaries may omit open water or differ at river borders; explicit source county is not replaced by an approximate map.
Public source facts are reproduced with agency and WQP attribution; no blanketCC0 license or provider endorsement is claimed.
